title.en: Compute M.D. about the mean and the median
Find the coefficient of mean deviation

say.en: Deviations from the mean always add up to zero, so their plain average is useless. Drop the signs and the average distance from the centre appears. In this lesson: Compute M.D. about the mean and the median.
Find the coefficient of mean deviation.

body.en: *Mean deviation* is the arithmetic mean of the absolute deviations from an average A (mean or median): $M.D. = \sum |x - A| / n$ for raw data and $\sum f|x - A| / N$ for a frequency distribution (use mid-points for classes). Coefficient of M.D. $= M.D./A$. It is least when taken about the median.
body.kn: ಸರಾಸರಿ ವಿಚಲನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಂದು ಸರಾಸರಿ A (ಸರಾಸರಿ ಅಥವಾ ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ) ದಿಂದ ನಿರಪೇಕ್ಷ ವಿಚಲನೆಗಳ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ: M.D. = Σ|x − A|/n; ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ವಿತರಣೆಗೆ Σf|x − A|/N. ಗುಣಾಂಕ = M.D./A. ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕದ ಸುತ್ತ ತೆಗೆದಾಗ ಅದು ಕನಿಷ್ಠ.

say.en: Ignoring signs is its main weakness.
Least about the median.
Plot the eight values 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13 and 17. Their mean is ten.
Measure each distance from ten, ignoring the sign: 6, 3, 2, 1, 0, 2, 3 and 7.
Average those distances: twenty-four by eight is three. That is the mean deviation.
Divide by the mean for the coefficient: three by ten, 0.3.

problem.en: Find M.D. about the mean and its coefficient: 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 17.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Find M.D. about the mean and its coefficient: 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 17.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Find M.D. about the mean and its coefficient: 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 17.
Mean equals 80 over 8 equals 10.
M.D. = 24 over 8 equals 3.
Coefficient equals 3 over 10 equals 0.3.
So the answer is M.D. = 3; coefficient equals 0.3.

problem.en: Find M.D. about the median: x = 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 with f = 3, 7, 10, 6, 4.

steps.en: N = 30; cumulative frequencies 3, 10, 20, 26, 30. N/2 = 15, so median = 20.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Find M.D. about the median: x = 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 with f = 3, 7, 10, 6, 4.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Find M.D. about the median: x equals 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 with f equals 3, 7, 10, 6, 4.
N equals 30; cumulative frequencies 3, 10, 20, 26, 30. N over 2 equals 15, so median equals 20.
f|x minus 20| = 30, 35, 0, 30, 40; sum equals 135.
M.D. = 135 over 30 equals 4.5.
Coefficient equals 4.5 over 20 equals 0.225.
So the answer is M.D. about median equals 4.5; coefficient equals 0.225.
